reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the classification: fees are license, access, maintenance, revenue-share on revenue Corio actually invoices, and time-and-materials implementation capped by SOW - all order- or usage-based, with no take-or-pay, quota or shortfall penalty imposed on Corio (our party).

The two 'minimum'/'shortfall' hits are correctly read as non-adverse: the 40-user threshold conditions a revenue-share waiver in Corio's favour, and the p0059 shortfall language is a reciprocal audit true-up, i.e. the mechanic the playbook prefers over a penalty.

Sub-elements short of preferred (annual maintenance fees over a five-year term with no convenience termination, and the p0205 commercially reasonable efforts to obtain two customer orders) are appropriately noted in the rationale rather than flagged, and the term/termination point is correctly deferred to avoid double-flagging.
No deterministic check failures; no over-flagging or directional error.
